NSCameraUsageDescription: Everly needs access to your camera to take photos for events.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Everly needs access to your microphone for video recording.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Everly needs access to your photo library to upload photos to events.
NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Everly needs to send you notifications about event updates and reveals.
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Everly uses this to measure ad performance and improve your experience. Your data is never sold.
